stop_rules.note: a 429 is waited out with a doubling pause and the same request is asked again; three in a row end the run; no other address, no proxy, no retry around a refusal

purpose: History Miner depth count, part A: settled-market lists from the historical endpoint for TIE3's NHL period, NHL overtime and NFL quarter series, to count how many settled events exist before the live endpoint's range (about 2026-09-07). Listing only.
heldout: none: the historical endpoint holds only markets that closed before about 2026-09-07, which is before every registered held-out date of TIE3 (2026-11-13), MAPBREAK (2026-10-23) and NHLOT; a listing, no candle, no rule scored, zero tries
notes: Pages are newest first, 1,000 markets a page. A short last page means the series' start was reached and the count is exact; a full last page means the count is a floor. About 2.2 KB a market (measured on KXBTC15M), so at most 28 pages is about 62 to 90 MB. Part B is a separate run only to stay well under the 200 MB a run cap.
